name: AI圆桌lite
worktreeHint: Each task installs its own npm ci dependencies. Read .agents/TESTING.md. No dependency junctions.
notes: Explicit releases only; no version bump, remote push, or publication on ordinary merges.
After each local merge, afterMerge installs dist into C:/VibeData/Extensions/AI-Yuanzhuo-Lite, the folder the user loads once; the extension then offers an in-place update.
Chrome MV3, one roundtable per window, main reading Tab with A/B/C views (A default), operations sidepanel; 2–3 of DeepSeek, Kimi, Doubao, Qwen, Yuanbao, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
Fixture browsers are isolated. Real account login and live site tests are separate from offline merge gates.

User-approved debugger wake/focus support is limited to active request tabs and released afterwards. No MAIN world patches, DNR, PPT, token dashboards, silent truncation, or automatic uncertain resend.
